messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate on infer-us-west-1 /v1/generate — 6.8% over 5m. Pager: @alice_oncall. Affected nodes: infer-worker-5, infer-worker-7, gateway-2.

alice_oncall: Oncall here — investigating. Pulling logs and will start live mitigations.

carla_sre: Any initial customer impact numbers? :thinking_face:

evie_support: Support: 3 open tickets from Acme Corp + 1 live call. All report 502 or timeout during inference requests.

dmitri_engineer: I see repeated SIGSEGV in model-runner on infer-worker-7. Tail of relevant log: 

```
[2026-03-17T09:01:12Z] model-runner[pid=3245]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f... sp 00007ff... error 6 in libattention.so
#0 0x7f8a1b2c in kv_cache::append()
#1 0x7f8a3c4d in attention::forward()
#2 0x55aa9f0 in model::generate()
```

ben_runtime: Pattern matches a double-free in the quantized attention kernel when sequence length > 1024. Immediate mitigations I recommend:
- Route 30% traffic to fallback-model (non-quant, smaller)
- Reduce gateway batch_size to 1 for /v1/generate
- Disable kernel 'quant_attn_v2' on affected workers (env flag)

alice_oncall: @ops-bot please run: `reroute --from infer-us-west-1 --to fallback-pool --percent 30` and `gatewayctl set /v1/generate batch_size=1`

ops-bot: Command received. Executing reroute...
ops-bot: Reroute applied -> fallback-pool 30% (backend ids: 10-13). Gateway config updated: batch_size=1 for /v1/generate.

dmitri_engineer: Draining infer-worker-7 now and restarting model-runner with env `DISABLE_QUANT=1`. Will attach hotfix after restart.

carla_sre: Monitoring queue depth and GPU mem. Watch for evictions during restarts.

ben_runtime: Hotfix (free-guard) built, will deploy to drained nodes only. Scheduling patch deploy to infer-worker-5 and infer-worker-7.

ops-bot: infer-worker-7 restart complete. model-runner v2.1-hotfix deployed on infer-worker-7. Metrics update: 5xx -> 1.2% (5m).

incident-bot: [UPDATE] 5xx rate reduced to 1.2% over 5m. Customer-impact trending down. Continue monitoring for 30m. Paging cleared; follow-up meeting scheduled in 30m.

evie_support: I'll send a customer update to Acme and include a credit template.

alice_oncall: Thanks all. Owners for follow-ups: RCA -> dmitri_engineer, customer comms -> evie_support, infra hardening -> carla_sre. We'll capture additional logs for postmortem.
